items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Were some of the prominent clarinet men more or less your idols in those days? Goodman or Shaw?

ctx.x: Oh no, no. But I experimented playing jazz from as soon as I started playing the clarinet at all.
